texts:
Wednesday's practice reports, team by team: a Thursday night questionable tag, an Eagles back to IR and a stack of stars who sat out.

#GoPackGo Matthew Golden

#OnePride Jahmyr Gibbs

#RavensFlock Lamar Jackson

Let's get into it.

#GoPackGo Matthew Golden was limited Wednesday with the shoulder and foot after missing Monday and Tuesday. Green Bay lists him as questionable for Thursday vs CAR.

WR11 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week. Monitor Thursday's inactives at 6:45 PM ET.

#KeepPounding Jalen Coker practiced in full Wednesday with the shoulder and has no injury designation for Thursday at GB.

WR15 for me this week, a WR2.

#FlyEaglesFly Dameon Pierce went on injured reserve Wednesday with the injury from Monday night, so he misses at least four games. Philadelphia promoted Jaydon Blue from the practice squad.

Pierce is RB70 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the wire.

#FlyEaglesFly Saquon Barkley sat out Wednesday's walkthrough with the hamstring and back. Jaydon Blue and Elijah Mitchell are the backs behind him.

RB18 for me this week at WAS, an RB2. Monitor Thursday's Eagles injury report.

#RaiseHail Stefon Diggs did not practice Wednesday with the hand, the hamstring and a rest day, and Dan Quinn says he is back Thursday.

WR21 for me vs PHI, a WR2. Monitor Thursday's Commanders practice report.

#RavensFlock Lamar Jackson was a full participant Wednesday with the ankle, per ESPN, after three straight missed games.

QB4 for me this week at BUF.

#OnePride Jahmyr Gibbs did not practice Wednesday with a shoulder injury from an awkward slide vs GB, a game in which he played a season-high 90 percent of the snaps.

The No. 2 back on my Menu this week vs MIN. Monitor Thursday's Lions practice report.

#OnePride Amon-Ra St. Brown sat out Wednesday with the ankle, as Dan Campbell planned, and the plan is to get him going Thursday.

WR6 for me this week vs MIN. Monitor Thursday's Lions practice report.

#Skol Aaron Jones Sr. did not practice Wednesday with the knee he aggravated vs IND. Adam Schefter reports it is not considered significant.

RB33 for me at DET, a low-end RB3. Monitor Friday's Vikings injury report.
Jordan Mason is RB22, an RB2.

#JetUp Breece Hall was limited Wednesday with the quad after four missed games.

RB20 for me vs LV, an RB2. Monitor Friday's Jets injury report.

Braelon Allen (ankle) was limited too. RB27 for me, a high-end RB3.

#RaiderNation Brock Bowers was limited Wednesday with a calf injury.

TE2 for me this week at NYJ. Monitor Friday's Raiders injury report.

#BirdGang Jeremiyah Love was limited Wednesday with the ankle after two missed games, and Mike LaFleur says he is in line to play at DAL.

RB24 for me this week, an RB2. Monitor Friday's Cardinals injury report.

#BirdGang Jacoby Brissett stays Arizona's starter at DAL, per Mike LaFleur, after 48 throws vs DEN. Carson Beck's back is still being checked.

QB11 for me, a borderline start this week.

#DallasCowboys George Pickens was limited in Wednesday's walkthrough with the shoulder and hamstring.

WR13 for me vs ARI, borderline WR1/WR2 this week. Monitor Friday's Cowboys injury report.

#BroncosCountry Jaylen Waddle did not practice Wednesday with the chest he aggravated at ARI, and Ian Rapoport says his status for KC is not decided.

WR41 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Monitor Friday's Broncos injury report.

#WeAreTheKrewe Emeka Egbuka was limited Wednesday with the concussion and foot, still in the protocol.

WR31 for me vs ATL, a low-end WR3. Monitor Friday's Buccaneers injury report.

#WeAreTheKrewe Kenny Gainwell did not practice Wednesday with a hip injury.

RB34 for me vs ATL, a low-end RB3. Monitor Thursday's Buccaneers practice report.
Bucky Irving is RB14, borderline RB1/RB2.

#WhoDey Ja'Marr Chase did not practice Wednesday, listed with rest and the ankle, and was in the locker room afterward.

WR3 for me this week vs TEN. Monitor Thursday's Bengals practice report.

Every Wednesday note is on the Pass, and the Menu has the Week 8 ranks with Golden's questionable tag.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Thursday's Serve or Sit, and like this if it helps your lineup.
